row.team_price_text: Pro (CVE Shield): $750/mo billed annually ($9,000/yr), up to 5 users
row.evidence: The pricing page puts 'Enterprise access controls: RBAC, SAML SSO' only on the quote-based Enterprise tier, and Contrast's SCIM 2.0 docs require RBAC enforced and SSO set up first, with SCIM enabled by Customer Success.
row.notes: New row. The public pricing page covers the new CVE Shield product: Free (single user), Pro ($750/month billed annually, flat, up to 5 users, 'available soon') and Enterprise (custom quote, consumption pricing by production hosts) with RBAC and SAML SSO. The core Contrast platform (Assess, ADR, Scan) is sold by quote. SCIM 2.0 (SaaS only, not on-premises TeamServer) needs RBAC enforced and SSO configured, and Customer Success or Support must enable it, so the gate is Enterprise / Contact Sales; the plan comes from combining the pricing page (RBAC and SSO on Enterprise) with the docs, hence confidence medium. Okta setup uses Okta's generic 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token)' and Entra a non-gallery app (the Entra gallery app is SAML SSO with JIT only), so both are via_generic. Pro is flat priced, so per-user fields are null.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Talk to sales for a quote (annual consumption pricing by production hosts)
plans.notes: SCIM inferred: requires RBAC and SSO (Enterprise access controls) and must be enabled by Contrast.

auth.token_source: Register an OAuth2 client (up to 3 per organisation) via POST /api/v4/organizations/{organizationUuid}/oauth2/configuration, then use client credentials at https://<your-contrast-host>/scim/oauth2/token (scope 'read write').
auth.token_expiry: 60 minutes by default; tokenTtlMinutes up to 388800 (9 months) for Okta's static bearer token

deprovision.data_retained: Okta unassignment deactivates the user (account kept). Entra deactivates immediately and then deletes the account after Entra's 30-day soft-delete window. A disabled user cannot log in or use API keys; settings are kept and reapplied on re-enable.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count, default count 100; no maximum stated.

roles.how: No role attribute; SCIM groups become User Access Groups with no default roles, and an admin assigns roles to each group in the Contrast UI.

limitations.text: Login email (userName) is immutable; UPN changes are acknowledged but not applied.
SCIM-provisioned groups get no role assignments until an admin adds roles manually.
Group membership changes take about 60 seconds to apply because of caching.
Okta uses a static bearer token (max 9 months) that does not auto-refresh; provisioning stops silently when it expires.
Entra must use a separate non-gallery Enterprise Application for provisioning (the gallery app does SSO only).

scim.notes: Available for Contrast SaaS organisations only (Classic and Northstar), not on-premises TeamServer. Must be enabled by Customer Success or Support; RBAC must be enforced.

endpoints.purpose: Add user to user access group
Assign role to user access group

user_api.notes: Access Control API v4 (hosted customers only) manages users, roles, user access groups and resource groups. Requests use an API-Key header plus an Authorization header.

okta.notes: No Contrast app in the OIN; Contrast documents provisioning through Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token).

entra.notes: Gallery app is SAML SSO with JIT; SCIM provisioning uses a separate non-gallery app per Contrast's docs.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP / Active Directory (on-premises TeamServer); SAML group attribute (contrast_groups) adds and removes group membership at login
